## Problem Set

### Exercise 5.1
Execute a derivation in the Carnap checker using Universal Introduction.

~~~{.ProofChecker.ZachTFL}
1. ∀x (Fx -> Gx) : PR
2. ∀x Fx : PR
3. | a : AS
4. | Fa -> Ga : ∀E 1
5. | Fa : ∀E 2
6. | Ga : ->E 4, 5
7. ∀x Gx : ∀I 3-6
~~~
